title: Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band live: Casino Rama, Rama | 2003
content:
Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band performed at the Casino Rama in Rama, Ontario, Canada, on 25 July 2003.

It was the second show by the eighth All-Starr Band, and the first of two consecutive nights in Rama. Their tour of North America lasted for 35 dates between July and September 2003.

Starr had previously performed at the Casino Rama on 26 July 2001. He returned there on 14 and 15 June 2006, 19 and 20 June 2008, 24 and 25 June 2010, 6 June 2014, and 27 and 28 May 2022.

The eighth All-Starr Band

  • Ringo Starr: vocals, drums, percussion
  • Colin Hay: vocals, guitar
  • Paul Carrack: vocals, guitar, keyboards
  • John Waite: vocals, bass guitar, guitar
  • Mark Rivera: vocals, saxophone, percussion, guitar, bass, harmonica, flute
  • Sheila E: vocals, drums, percussion
